採用・広告の製品.quote: Our mission is to help the world embrace the circular economy and say goodbye to the days of owning expensive tech devices. It’s a learned behaviour that we need to disrupt to usher in a new era where subscribing, rather than buying, is the norm. We’ve seen this trend with luxury handbags, clothes and cars. There’s no surprise that tech is the next big trend here.

A circular economy is a sustainable approach to production and consumption. Rather than following the "take-make-waste" linear model, the circular economy aims to reduce waste and protect the environment.

We’re all addicted to our devices (and that’s ok), but what we’re actually addicted to is the lifestyle they allow us to live and the connections they help us make. We don’t need to own the device to do this. Circular is helping people embrace a forward thinking approach where we are custodians of devices for a period of time, before they're passed on to the next consumer.
Circular provides innovative and sustainable solutions to businesses and individuals in Singapore and Australia.
Approved subscription
At Circular, you'll have the independence to use your creativity and skills, with the support of like-minded individuals dedicated to transforming the way we approach business.

Our business subscriptions are designed to balance affordability and flexibility. We’re an obvious first choice for sustainability minded businesses. However the subscription model appeals broadly as it enables businesses to unlock cash flow. We’re proud to help power and enable growth across a growing network of businesses in Singapore and Australia.

To create an evolution of the tech space and its economy: it’s no secret that modern supply chains and industries are placing our planet under immense pressure. Our model is committed to helping lessen this over the long term.

We want to match our subscription model to lifestyle, so by revolutionising the tech space and making tech so much more accessible, people will be able to better express themselves, create, connect, play, and work. Through this approach, we are broadening opportunities for people to connect to the life they want. And we don’t empower only the elites; we do so for all.
Call out waste: strive for constant improvement in everything we do
Prefer principles to rules: trust judgement in applying principles to situations
Be Present: Live in the present and appreciate milestones
Seek Unusual Knowledge: We prioritise learning and truth
Ask "why" often: challenge past decisions and continuously improve
Explain your reasoning: proactively share the reasons behind your choices

Prior to co-founding Circular, Nick was the COO, CTO and CPO at MoneySmart Group. Nick’s first start-up was acquired by PropertyGuru Group, which he joined as Head of Product. Prior to arriving in Singapore he was a strategy consultant with Deloitte in Europe.

12+ years experience working in Software Engineering across government, agency, and product-based start-ups in Australia and Singapore. Ben’s career has focused on delivering high-quality customer experiences by bridging the gap between design, user experience principles, and back-end development.
17+ years experience, including the last 8+ years in Product in APAC across marketplace, device insurance and consumer electronics e-commerce (Telco)

Pantha started his career as a quant/trader at UBS. In his second life, he has been building products and product teams around APAC. He has held senior leadership positions at early stage startups like igloo as well as late stage ones like Circles.Life.
10+ years experience, including 7+ years experience in logistics in SE-Asia across large and small scale 3PL providers.
Prior to co-founding Circular, George has held senior leadership positions at NinjaVan (Head of Sea Freight) and Janio, a Sequoia backed company (Head of B2B).

Emelia started her career at KPMG as a management consultant before transitioning to the audit division of the firm, specialising in the Energy & Technology sector. She has experience working with early to late-stage startups in the eCommerce, hospitality and healthcare space. Prior to being in Circular, Emelia held a leadership position in a marketing firm in Singapore.

WenJie brings 10+ years of operations experience across logistics, customer success, retail, and military HR/legal. He was one of the youngest Team Leads at Sony Singapore and managed key clients like Sumitomo Chemicals at PIL Logistics. At Circular, he oversees operations across procurement, subscriptions & damage cover, while building internal tools to support scale and CX.
Prior to Circular, Russell was the Chief Collections Officer at Indebted, a high growth consumer debt recovery startup.

Paul has over 20 years of experience working for high profile companies in Australia, Singapore and the United Kingdom. Paul's expertise is in using data, analytics and problem solving to improve credit risk management, identity verification, fraud prevention, portfolio management and collections policies and processes to help companies to attract, onboard and manage customers.
At Circular, you'll have the independence to use your creativity and skills, with the support of like-minded individuals dedicated to transforming the way we approach business.

Straight up - being a great place to work is our top priority. We believe in creating an environment where driven individuals come together to learn and grow, all while making a meaningful impact every single day.

At Circular, you can expect a collaborative and transparent culture where everyone has the freedom to excel in their job. We celebrate progress and value truth above all else. Join us and be a part of something truly special.

You heard it right. We trust your ability to reach deadlines and excel at your work, while also understanding the importance of taking breaks. At Circular, we encourage you to prioritise what's best for both the company and yourself.

Your health and wellbeing matter to us. That's why we subsidise activities like gym memberships, spa visits and therapy sessions. And if you're based in Singapore, you'll also receive private health insurance.

As advocates of the circular economy, we believe in practising what we preach. So we provide Circular credits to our full time team members each month. Use them to get the latest tech gadgets for yourself, your family, and loved ones.

We understand the importance of family. From day one, we’re proud to offer progressive parental leave policies. Whether you're the primary carer (20 weeks) or secondary carer (16 weeks), you'll have time off to embrace this new stage of life.

We're invested in your growth and success. Explore exciting and challenging projects, take advantage of opportunities for learning and development, and benefit from the guidance of our experienced leadership team. We also have a flexible remote work policy and a company offsite in fun locations like Bali.
